MORSE applies a user centered development process. We continuously engage with our users to better understand their needs and gather feedback as a project progresses. We pride ourselves in our hands-on approach to field testing alongside users in operationally representative conditions.
The MORSE team is a talented group of Engineers, Software Developers, and Scientists with a diverse set of technical capabilities.
With our initial roots in Aerospace Engineering, we have developed a strong set of complementary skills. This allows us to develop leading edge technologies for various application spaces.
